type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: issue_mandate
functions.doc:
Authorize an agent key to spend from the caller's vault within limits.
 Re-issuing for the same key replaces the mandate (spent resets to 0; nonces stay burned).

functions.doc: One-shot state migration adding the guarantor collections. Call once after redeploy.

functions.doc: Stake NEAR to become a solver. Stake backs the IOUs you underwrite.

functions.doc: Move unused reserve back to free stake.

functions.name: request_pull_signature
functions.doc:
Ask the NEAR MPC network to sign a foreign-chain transaction hash on behalf of this
 contract. `payload_hex` = 32-byte tx hash, `path` = derivation path (e.g. "sepolia-1").
 The derived foreign address is deterministic per (this contract, path). Solver-only.

functions.name: request_withdraw
functions.doc:
Queue a withdrawal. Solvers stop accepting IOUs from this vault while one is pending,
 and have `withdraw_delay_ns` to settle what they already underwrote.

functions.name: reserve_for_issuer
functions.doc: Earmark `amount` of the caller's stake for `issuer`. Certs for this issuer draw on it.

functions.name: set_guarantee_key
functions.doc: Register the ed25519 key this solver signs guarantee certs with (32 raw bytes).

functions.name: settle_batch
functions.doc:
Settle a batch of agent-signed IOUs in one transaction.
 Invalid IOUs are reported in `rejected`, never panic the whole batch.

functions.name: settle_pull
functions.doc:
Settle pull outcomes for signed certs. Callable by the cert's solver or its issuer, so the
 issuer can always enforce a guarantee itself. Failed pulls pay `payout` from the reserve to
 the issuer; successful pulls accrue the fee. Bad entries are rejected, never panic the batch.

functions.name: solver_withdraw
functions.doc: Withdraw stake (fees are credited to stake at settlement).

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc:
Claim a queued withdrawal after the delay. Pays whatever is still in the vault
 (settlements during the delay may have reduced it).

GuaranteeCert.description: What a solver signs off-chain when a card is swiped. The issuer approves the card network authorization on the strength of this; the contract pays `payout` if the pull fails. Byte layout must match `packages/protocol/src/cert.ts`.

chain_id.description: EIP-155 chain id of the pull (Sepolia = 11155111).

expires_at.description: Unix ns. Settlement must happen before this.

token.description: Token contract on the target chain, 0x-hex.

wallet.description: Payer wallet on the target chain, 0x-hex.

Iou.description: The message an agent signs. Encoded with borsh, prefixed by `IOU_DOMAIN`. The TypeScript side (`packages/protocol`) must produce byte-identical output.

agent_pk.description: Agent public key (32 bytes, ed25519), base64 in JSON.

expires_at.description: Unix time in nanoseconds; settlement must happen before this.

owner.description: Vault owner who will be debited.

fees_accrued.description: Fees owed by the issuer for successful pulls. ponytail: accrued, invoiced off-chain.

reserved.description: yoctoNEAR of solver stake earmarked for this issuer.
